column1: # Game profile of Devil May Cry 3 Special Edition (Switch, base v0 + update 1.0.1 = v65536)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Capcom's MT Framework-derived port on SDK 8.2.0, NVN, FMOD, NintendoSDK_movie (subsdk0).
# Shaders: 74 BNSH shaders (32 vertex, 42 pixel) embedded in main; no GLSLC in runtime and no BNSH/BAHS in RomFS (dmc3-0.nbz is a ZIP of .pac/.pack/.dds/.txt).
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize(0xC0000000) = 3072 MB
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# PEANUTS: game logic/physics step per frame at 60 Hz (running at 120 Hz doubles game speed); use LSFG 2x for 120 FPS output.
# PEANUTS: see Tested on in README.md (Qualcomm system driver on SM-X800 only exposes Vulkan 1.1; recommend Mesa Turnip)
